title: सोना महँगा हुआ, पर असली दौलत क्या है?
description: सोने-चाँदी के दाम आसमान पर हैं, पर असली दौलत क्या है? सेठ धनीराम और मोची रामू की यह कहानी आखिर तक देखिए।

hook.line: सोना महँगा हुआ, पर असली दौलत?

scenes.narration: दोस्तों, आज सोना आसमान छू रहा है, पर क्या सोना ही असली दौलत है?
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Wide cinematic shot of a glowing pile of gold bars and gold coins on a wooden table in front of a village window, a golden arrow rising up into a sunset sky, mud-house village in the distance. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: एक गाँव में सेठ धनीराम के पास सोने के ढेर थे।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Seth, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a thick black mustache, thin black stick limbs and a maroon kurta, standing proudly with arms spread wide inside a big village house, heaps of gold coins and gold bars piled around him. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: वो दिन रात बस सोना गिनता, किसी से बात तक नहीं करता था।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Seth, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a thick black mustache, thin black stick limbs and a maroon kurta, sitting alone and hunched on the floor of a dim empty room at night, counting gold coins by a small oil lamp, a long lonely shadow on the wall. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: उसी गाँव में गरीब मोची रामू रहता था।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Ramu, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, short black hair, thin black stick limbs and a faded blue kurta, sitting at his tiny roadside shoe repair stall under a big banyan tree, a worn shoe in his hands, a gentle smile, mud houses and a dirt lane behind him. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: रामू जो कमाता, उसमें से भूखों को रोटी खिला देता था।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Ramu, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, short black hair, thin black stick limbs and a faded blue kurta, handing rotis to four small stick children and one old stick man sitting in a row on a dusty village lane, kind posture. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: एक रात गाँव में भयंकर बाढ़ आ गई।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Wide cinematic shot of a raging muddy flood rushing through a village of mud houses on a stormy night, heavy rain, dark thunder clouds with a thin warm edge of light, debris floating in the brown water. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: सेठ अपनी सोने की पेटी लेकर भागा, पर कीचड़ में फँस गया।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Seth, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a thick black mustache, thin black stick limbs and a maroon kurta, stuck knee-deep in thick mud, hugging a heavy golden treasure chest with a frightened pose, rising flood water around him, stormy sky. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: उसने मदद के लिए चिल्लाया, पर किसी ने उसकी तरफ देखा तक नहीं।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Seth, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a thick black mustache, thin black stick limbs and a maroon kurta, shouting for help with one raised arm in rising flood water, behind him three small stick villagers walking away with their backs turned, stormy twilight sky. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: तभी रामू नाव लेकर आया और बोला, सेठ जी, हाथ पकड़िए।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Ramu, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, short black hair, thin black stick limbs and a faded blue kurta, rowing a small wooden boat through the flood with a glowing lantern at the bow, one arm stretched out to reach someone, rain and dark clouds. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: सेठ ने पेटी छोड़कर रामू का हाथ थाम लिया।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Seth, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a thick black mustache, thin black stick limbs and a maroon kurta, letting go of a golden chest and gripping the hand of Ramu, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, short black hair and a faded blue kurta, who pulls him into a small wooden boat, lantern light on the water. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: सोना बाढ़ में बह गया, पर सेठ की जान बच गई।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. A golden treasure chest sinking into dark muddy flood water in the foreground, in the background a small wooden boat with a glowing lantern carrying two stick characters, one with a maroon kurta and a thick black mustache and one with a faded blue kurta and short black hair. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: सुबह सेठ ने रामू को गले लगाकर कहा, असली दौलत इंसानियत है।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Sunrise after the flood, Seth, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a thick black mustache, thin black stick limbs and a maroon kurta, hugging Ramu, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, short black hair and a faded blue kurta, tears of gratitude, wet muddy ground and calm brown water behind them. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: उसने अपनी बाकी दौलत से गाँव वालों के लिए घर बनवाए।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Seth, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a thick black mustache, thin black stick limbs and a maroon kurta, standing happily beside a group of stick villagers building small new brick houses together, stacks of bricks, wooden ladders, a half-built wall, bright morning sun. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: अब पूरा गाँव उसे दुआएँ देता था, और वो सुकून की नींद सोता था।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. A crowd of stick villagers with folded hands blessing Seth, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a thick black mustache, thin black stick limbs and a maroon kurta, who smiles peacefully, calm village evening with a glowing orange sunset and small lanterns being lit. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: दोस्तों, सोना चमकता है, पर अच्छे कर्म हमेशा साथ रहते हैं।
